title: AegisAI, founded by former Google security execs, lands $36M to stop AI-driven spear phishing
slides: AegisAI has $36M, but can it stop what’s coming?
AI-generated spear phishing now bypasses most filters.
Its founders previously secured Google’s own infrastructure.
Your current email defenses are already obsolete.
Pause your next click until they prove it works.
thread_text:
1. $36M against what?

AegisAI raised $36M to fight AI-generated phishing that already bypasses most email filters.

2. The founders' history

They previously secured Google’s own infrastructure from attacks.

3. Your inbox is exposed

Current defenses can't catch these AI-crafted messages.

4. The real test

Until their system proves it works, treat every link as a threat.

5. Pause before you click

Take that email you almost opened and run it through a separate scanner first.

Spear phishing emails can now perfectly mimic your boss's writing style and bypass your spam filter. 😦

AegisAI just raised $36M to solve this problem. Its founders secured Google’s own systems—but these AI-generated messages already slip past most defenses.

Your current inbox protection is obsolete. 👀

Have you scanned that last email you almost opened through a separate tool yet? 🛑
